name: Staff of Earth and Stone
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 196, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 492
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 196, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 492
Aura moderate transmutation CL 11th
Slot none; Price 85,800 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
This staff is topped with a fist-sized emerald that gleams with smoldering power. It allows the use of the following spells:
Move earth (1 charge)
Passwall (1 charge)
Construction
Requirements Craft Staff, move earth, passwall; Cost 42,900 gp
